title: Cucumber Reporting preserves millisecond display precision
summary: On both Joda-Time versions, 18 deserialized report durations print seconds and three digits of truncated milliseconds in UTC and English.

change.description: On both Joda-Time versions, 18 deserialized report durations print seconds and three digits of truncated milliseconds in UTC and English.

notes: Disclosed external-upgrade calibration. The caller observations and preparation scope are recorded with the example.
Each selector picks one of three seconds, three millisecond values and two remainders; Jackson builds the real Result and the actual Joda formatter supplies the returned text.
